defaults_are_not_measurements.radius_px: Frames show a rounded card. The corner radius was not measured. 32px is a prototype default.
defaults_are_not_measurements.font_family: No font file was identified in the dataset. Inter is a family HyperFrames resolves by name.
defaults_are_not_measurements.caption_chip: Completed card references describe a maroon caption chip. This hex is an approximation, not a sampled color.
defaults_are_not_measurements.music_gain_under_speech: Set to the HyperFrames music-under-voice level. The reference analyst metered audio and did not listen to it, so no music title or measured ducking curve exists.
defaults_are_not_measurements.music_file: The proof of concept generates a quiet tone. It is not a track heard in any reference.
